mentions.name: No-AI programming video series
mentions.description: A video series of the author programming without AI assistance, working mainly on cherished personal projects, aiming to preserve and amplify the traditional craft of programming.
mentions.problem: Programming without AI assistance is fading from view; the series aims to keep an echo of the old ways alive.
mentions.source_excerpt: Pivoting into content creation. It's gonna be a series of videos of me programming, without AI assistance, so that some echo of the old ways persists, or at least is a little bit louder, for my having been here to preserve it.
mentions.author: bitwize
